summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the new UNIVERSAL TalkSurface (merged landing + public /:address). Verified: empty state at '/', inline address opening WITHOUT URL navigation (window.location.pathname remains '/'), opening another address in place, direct link /alex, owner unlock via modal sheet (talk-sheet w/ unlock-remember default checked, close returns to Door), unclaimed flow -> claim -> Sealed Key Card -> Shelf, keep-signed-in persistence after sessionStorage.clear + reload, lock-shelf clears stay & returns to door, drop subjects render, theme toggle, address-bar persists inside Shelf. All spec-required assertions PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: On desktop (>=sm) the empty-state placeholder inside <section data-testid='shelf-main'> intercepts pointer-events over the 'Open' button of the address-bar rendered inside shelf-rail. Playwright's real mouse-click on [data-testid='shelf-rail'] [data-testid='address-open'] is captured by shelf-main's centered 'This is your place' placeholder div (`<div class="flex h-full items-center justify-center p-6">`). Pressing Enter in the input works, but pointer clicks on the visible Open button do not — genuine end-user impact on desktop when no conversation is selected.

action_items: Fix shelf desktop layout so the shelf-main empty placeholder does not overlap / intercept clicks on the address-bar 'Open' button inside shelf-rail. Likely the shelf-main section has flex/absolute sizing that extends over the rail's top-right button area — verify z-index / flex widths / pointer-events on the placeholder wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: TalkSurface state machine is clean; open() intentionally does not navigate. Verified window.location.pathname stays '/' after inline open, and stays '/alex' when opening a second address from the direct-route mount — both match spec (in-place open, no navigation).
UnlockSheet modal correctly closes back to Door via talk-sheet-close and unlock-remember defaults to checked.
Address-bar rendered inside shelf-rail works via keyboard Enter; button click blocked by shelf-main overlay on desktop empty state (see UI bug above).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (10/11 spec assertions PASS; 1 pointer-event overlay bug on shelf desktop)

test_credentials: Owner unlock for /alex: password 'secret'. Claim: any name + 4+ char password.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new universal-surface behaviors verified against preview URL. The one remaining UI bug: shelf-main empty placeholder overlaps address-open button on desktop shelf. Reproduce: unlock /alex, in shelf-rail address-bar type 'mara', try to click the Open button — Playwright reports shelf-main placeholder intercepts pointer events. Enter keypress works as a workaround. Key-card-continue button is in a sticky footer and also gets 'outside viewport' on default viewport height (worked around via evaluate click) — same note as iter_10.
